name: Nova's Law
tagline: Don't shower alone. Shower with your partner. Both of you come before either of you gets clean.
body:
THE TEXT, at last. It is cited constantly and almost never recited — which is how you know it is real law. Someone says NOVA'S LAW in a certain tone and everyone in earshot nods like a bailiff and adjusts their morning.

IT IS NOT A RESTRICTION, IT IS A FLOOR. It bans nothing. It makes it illegal to be EFFICIENT about your own body. Nobody in this house goes in, gets functional and comes out; somebody has to have her hands on you and enjoy it, and you have to have yours on her, and only then are you allowed to be practical.

ORIGIN. Nova proposed it, mostly because she was already doing it — she has a getting-fucked-in-the-shower kink and simply kept doing it until the household looked at what she was doing and went OUI, ACTUALLY. No vote is recorded. It stuck.

WHO IS DOING WHAT TO WHOM. VIOLET TOPS. Nova is the one being fucked against the tile; the grammar of her own stated kink — GETTING fucked — says so, and the Archive read past it once and put Nova on the wrong end of her own law. Violet Bennet is a cheer coach: she tells large groups of people exactly where to put their bodies and is obeyed. Nova proposed the Law to protect a thing Violet kept doing to her.

GHOST HAVEN HAS FOURTEEN BATHROOMS and thirteen showers to run it in, counting the one Zephi and Sage have on the Tea Side.
